For a circular arc with chord length \(L\) and sagitta \(h\) (the maximum distance from the chord to the arc), the radius is

\[
r=\frac{L^2+4h^2}{8h}.
\]

Measuring the arcs in the image (approximately, in pixels):

\[
\begin{array}{c|c|c|c}
\text{Arc} & L & h & r\\ \hline
R & 214 & 62 & 123.3\\
A & 248 & 124 & 124.0\\
B & 160 & 45 & 93.6\\
C & 220 & 45 & 156.9
\end{array}
\]

Thus, Arc A has the same radius as Arc R.

\]
